# Handpress

> Adds an in-place editor to a hand-written static site. A non-technical owner signs in with
> Google, clicks the page and types; saving writes the HTML files and commits them to git.
> No templating, no database, no build step.

Use it for: small hand-built sites (tens of pages), one or two editors, a design that matters.
Do not use it for: hundreds of pages, many simultaneous authors, server-side drafts or approval workflow,
content already in a database or a framework's content collection.

## Install

```
npm i -D handpress
npx handpress install ./public                                # editor.js + admin.html
npx handpress keys "public/*.html" --global "header, footer"  # adds data-e keys; re-run after hand-editing HTML
```

Load the editor only for editors, in the site's own script:

```
if (/(?:^|;\s*)ed=1/.test(document.cookie)) {
  var s = document.createElement('script'); s.src = '/editor.js'; s.defer = true;
  document.head.appendChild(s);
}
```

Server: a Cloudflare Worker (src/worker.js), or PHP on ordinary shared hosting
(`npx handpress install ./public_html --php` installs php/api.php plus Apache templates; saves
are live immediately there), or any host implementing the six endpoints below.
Configure with vars GITHUB_REPO, GITHUB_BRANCH, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and an EDITOR object of
{pages, dataFiles, globalBlocks, uploadDir, forceVisible}; secrets GITHUB_TOKEN, SESSION_SECRET,
ADMIN_EMAILS. Sign-in needs a Google OAuth client with the site's origin as an authorised origin.

## API

- GET  /api/config        {pages, dataFiles, globalBlocks, uploadDir, forceVisible, clientId}
- POST /api/login         {credential} Google ID token -> session cookie + readable `ed=1` cookie
- POST /api/logout
- GET  /api/me            {email} or 401
- GET  /api/file?path=    {path, content, sha}; refuses anything off the allowlist
- POST /api/save          {files:[{path, content|base64, sha}], message}; all files or none

## Keys

data-e="t12" text block · "m12" image · "i12" list item · data-e-list repeating container ·
a "g" prefix (gt12) means the element is inside a global block shared by every page.

## Design notes

The editor keeps two DOMs: the live page, and the page's source fetched from the server. Edits
apply to both, and only the source is saved, so a site's own JavaScript (rendered lists,
animated counters) never gets written into the files. Keys are how the two are matched.

Every change is an operation kept in the browser (localStorage; new uploads in IndexedDB) until
Save, so drafts survive Preview, other pages and reloads; Undo/Redo drop and restore the last one.
Save replays each edited page's operations onto the current file and commits all in one commit.

Editors can: type text; bold/italic/links/colour/size/font; duplicate, move, remove, copy and paste
blocks and whole sections (<main> is keyed as a list), including across pages; replace images;
change YouTube embeds (iframe .../embed/ID or [data-yt-id]) and audio (<audio>, [data-audio]);
edit <select> options; edit page meta; edit the data file as a form; use the AI panel (movable;
pick any keyed block on the page, then: rewrite its words in place — data-e keys are checked and
preserved —, redesign it (replace, layout may change), build inside it (append), or add after it;
results show as a preview and as hand-editable HTML; "Edit HTML" edits a block's HTML directly).
The AI is given the page's CSS rules and HTML outline. Free models through OpenRouter or opencode
Zen, provider and model chosen in the panel, called directly from the browser; the owner's key is
stored in localStorage encrypted with a non-extractable AES-GCM key kept in IndexedDB, and sent
only to that provider. Generated HTML is sanitized and committed as an ordinary op (after | in |
replace | text), so it undoes, drafts and saves like any typed change.
New pages: EDITOR.newPages (PHP: new_pages) lets editors create top-level name.html pages (not
admin.html; a file sent without a sha must not exist). "New page" copies the head and global blocks
around <main data-e-canvas>, an empty canvas built with the AI. `handpress blank page.html` writes a
blank canvas page to start a site from nothing. The keying script keys a data-e-canvas element as a
list even when empty.

Per-site quirks and extras go in window.EDITOR_HOOKS: beforeEdit(el) to detach an element the site
animates; syncUnit(sourceEl, liveEl) to keep an attribute in step with edited text (liveEl may be
null); dataRegions [[selector, file, path, label]] for on-page handles on lists drawn from data;
dataChanged(path, obj) to redraw from unsaved data; blocks [[label, html]] for "+ New"; fonts
[[label, css]] for Style; guide {page: [[tip, selector]]} for the per-page Guide; ai
{context: brand-voice notes, provider: 'openrouter'|'opencode', model: that provider's default model
id, actions: [[label, instruction]]} for the AI assistant.
Uploads (uploadDir): jpg png webp gif svg mp3 m4a ogg.
